subject: Recap: Discovery call & mutual action plan (NovusHealth)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Patel <samira@novushealth.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@novushealth.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Discovery call & mutual action plan (NovusHealth)

Hi Samira / Marcus —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align on milestones, owners, and decision checkpoints so we can keep momentum. I put the most important items up front.

Key pain / goals you confirmed:
- Current triage chatbot returns clinically irrelevant answers ~30% of the time; this drives manual review and slows throughput.
- Goal: reduce manual escalation by 50% for first-line triage and keep 95%+ precision on high-risk flags.
- Compliance: data residency in us-east, strict logging and audit trails, SOC 2 evidence required for procurement.

Proposed pilot scope (30 days):
- Ingest triage logs (anonymized) + sample prompts (~2000 sessions).
- Run inference behind NovusHealth VPC peering; Redwood Dedicated pool with KV caching.
- Acceptance: 50% reduction in manual escalations OR equivalent throughput improvement at <= $0.02/token unit economics.

Milestones & owners (draft):
1) Data transfer readiness — Novus (Marcus) — target: 2026-07-08
2) Security intake & SOC2 doc exchange — Redwood (Ben) — target: 2026-07-09
3) Pilot deploy & smoke tests — Redwood (Marissa) — target: 2026-07-15
4) Evaluation window (2 weeks) — Novus owners (clinical lead) + Redwood — target: 2026-07-29
5) Decision / next steps — mutual — target: 2026-08-05

Open questions I flagged during the call:
- Are we ok with pseudonymized PHI in the transfer for training/analysis? (Marcus)
- Who will be the legal contact for the PO and SOW?
- Do you have an internal SLA/availability requirement beyond our standard Dedicated terms?

I attached a one-page MAP and my notes from the call. Please review and confirm or suggest edits; if this looks right we can lock dates and I’ll send an updated MAP workbook.

Attachments:
- Novus_Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft)
- discovery-notes.txt (call notes)

Next step: If you confirm, I’ll book a 30-min kickoff to walk through the data handoff checklist.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive 
Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Samira Patel <samira@novushealth.ai>

Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery call & mutual action plan (NovusHealth)

Thanks Ben — appreciate the crisp summary. A few quick notes and clarifications: 

1) Pseudonymized PHI is acceptable for the pilot but we need the exact anonymization steps documented and signed off by our compliance team. I’ll loop in our compliance manager if we move forward.
2) Procurement contact: procurement@novushealth.ai will handle PO/SOW — they asked for a SOC2 summary up front.
3) Timeline: 2026-07-08 for data transfer is tight — can we move that to 2026-07-12? We have a scheduled maintenance next week that slows data exports.

I reviewed the MAP draft — overall looks good. Two quick edits: add an explicit rollback plan if the pilot triggers false positives on high-risk content; and add a dedicated point for model explainability requests (we have clinicians who will need traceability).

I’m attaching the SOC2 evidence request form that procurement uses — they prefer to see a redwood-soc2-summary.pdf or similar.

Onboarding kickoff: Wed 2026-07-14 10:00 AM ET works for our team if that fits for you.

Best,
Samira
Samira Patel
